theorems.name: Submission.frt_plane_subset_hasDensity_one
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (P : Grassmannian N n) (T : Set (Euclidean N)), T ⊆ (P.plane : Set (Euclidean N)) → ∃ Z : Set (Euclidean N), (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) Z = 0 ∧ ∀ a ∈ T, a ∉ Z → HasDensity n ((μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict T) a 1
